<\STATESEP>chapter "ARM Object Invocations"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory ArchInvocation_A
imports Structures_A
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context Arch begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>global_naming ARM_A<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype flush_type = Clean | Invalidate | CleanInvalidate | Unify<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype page_directory_invocation =
    PageDirectoryFlush (pd_flush_type: flush_type) (pd_flush_start: vspace_ref)
                       (pd_flush_end: vspace_ref) (pd_flush_pstart: word32)
                       (pd_flush_pd: obj_ref) (pd_flush_asid: asid)
  | PageDirectoryNothing<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype page_table_invocation =
    PageTableMap cap cslot_ptr pde obj_ref
  | PageTableUnmap cap cslot_ptr<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype asid_control_invocation =
    MakePool obj_ref cslot_ptr cslot_ptr asid<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype asid_pool_invocation =
    Assign asid obj_ref cslot_ptr<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype page_invocation
     = PageMap
         (page_map_asid: asid)
         (page_map_cap: cap)
         (page_map_ct_slot: cslot_ptr)
         (page_map_entries: "pte \<times> (obj_ref list) + pde \<times> (obj_ref list)")
     | PageUnmap
         (page_unmap_cap: arch_cap)
         (page_unmap_cap_slot: cslot_ptr)
     | PageFlush
         (page_flush_type: flush_type)
         (page_flush_start: vspace_ref)
         (page_flush_end: vspace_ref)
         (page_flush_pstart: word32)
         (page_flush_pd: obj_ref)
         (page_flush_asid: asid)
     | PageGetAddr
         (page_get_paddr: obj_ref)<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype arch_invocation
     = InvokePageTable page_table_invocation
     | InvokePageDirectory page_directory_invocation
     | InvokePage page_invocation
     | InvokeASIDControl asid_control_invocation
     | InvokeASIDPool asid_pool_invocation<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype arch_copy_register_sets = ARMNoExtraRegisters<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition "ArchDefaultExtraRegisters \<equiv> ARMNoExtraRegisters"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype arch_irq_control_invocation =
    ArchIRQControlIssue irq cslot_ptr cslot_ptr bool<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
